name: equipment-maintenance-hub
description: Polyglot monorepo: Angular 22 frontend, FastAPI backend, shared OpenAPI contract.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:repo && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run backend:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run backend:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run backend:test
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run backend:build
scripts.contract:generate: npm run contract:generate:ts && npm run contract:generate:py
scripts.verify: npm run verify:contract && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.backend:dev: uv run --directory apps/backend python -c "print('TODO: start FastAPI dev server')"
scripts.backend:lint: uv run --directory apps/backend ruff check && uv run --directory apps/backend ruff format --check
scripts.backend:format: uv run --directory apps/backend ruff check --fix && uv run --directory apps/backend ruff format
